page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: Supperachios, rursum Gronenbergios, Gronenbekios, Selwerdios, familias nobiles, interdum conjunctim, interdum divisim. Post, cùm ad Coverdios hæreditas Selwerdiorum transisset cum Idâ hærede unicâ atque ultimâ domus istius, Hermanno Coverdio denuptâ, emphy-teusis inducta est; jure an injuria, nescio. Emphyteutæ facti Ioannes & Reinoldus Coverdii cum singulis filiis, & Goverdus Hovius anno Christi M. CCC, LXXI, mor-tuo paulo ante episcopo Ioanne Vernen-burgio: lex his dicta, ut emphy-teusis du-raret ad tempus vitæ ipsorum. Verùm ut suburbanus præfectus limitibus arctis fi-nitum imperium in plebem rusticam ha-bebat, nec causas cognoscebat, aut sen-tentias ferebat sine collegio judicum, quos plebs ei assessores dabat, plebsque in cæ-teris libertate fruebatur suâ; sic prætoria potestas in urbe collata ab episcopo jurif-dictionem senatus, & imperium ejusdem, ut falsò quidam credunt, non tollebat. page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the bottom right; the catchword "quam" is read from the image and is fairly clear. Spelling and printed hyphens are kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Possible doubt: "Vernenburgio" and "Ioanne" are clear enough but the scan is soft in places.
